en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, ornate multi‑storey institutional building with mansard roofs and decorative gables, fronted by an iron fence and gate along a street where a few people are walking. The right side and lower part of the card contain handwritten text. Printed text in Hungarian appears vertically along the left margin and at the upper right.
